name: FIL'MOSKOP UZHASOV: Zeljonye Glaza
source:
"Running, running down the wall
Green Eyes...
The girl will be strangled
Yes, yes, yes.."

The story tells about a girl Dasha from the 4th "B" class, who disobeyed her mother and listened to a green record. Together with her, you will face a mysterious and terrible evil, and only you can decide what awaits her in the end ^___^

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3150620/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“跑，跑下墙
绿眼睛…
女孩会被勒死
是的，是的，是的……”

故事讲述了四B班的女孩达莎不听妈妈的话，听了一张绿色唱片。你将与她一起面对神秘而可怕的邪恶，只有你才能决定最终等待着她的是什么^___^

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3150620/]Steam[/url]]
